title.zh: 将位于索索贡省索索贡市镇马加利亚内斯的马加利亚内斯南中央学校更名为Eduardo Lee Chan纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Magallanes South Central School Located in Magallanes, Sorsogon, Province of Sorsogon, To Eduardo Lee Chan Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Magallanes South Central School Located in Magallanes, Sorsogon, Province of Sorsogon, To Eduardo Lee Chan Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Trung tâm Magallanes South tại Tỉnh Sorsogon, Tỉnh Sorsogon thành Trường Tưởng niệm Eduardo Lee Chan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนกลาง Magallanes South ในจังหวัด Sorsogon จังหวัด Sorsogon เป็นโรงเรียนอนุสรณ์ Eduardo Lee Chan
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Pusat Magallanes South di Provinsi Sorsogon, Provinsi Sorsogon menjadi Sekolah Memorial Eduardo Lee Chan
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Pusat Magallanes South di Wilayah Sorsogon, Wilayah Sorsogon kepada Sekolah Memorial Eduardo Lee Chan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7608_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Magallanes South Central School is hereby renamed as the Eduardo Lee Chan Memorial School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
